_comment: ASR fixes for stolen-focus. Pass 1 fixed the headline names; pass 2 (2026-09-26) fixed the second ring after a full sweep of every capitalised token in the VTT. Every entry is verified against the book or a public source. NOTE: a multi-word key may NOT span a line break — a YouTube cue body is two lines (plain rolling line + word-timed line), so a phrase split across those lines is a different pair of tokens; use single-token keys (Oza/Aza + Rascin/Raskin) instead. RESOLVED IN THE VTT, NOT HERE (2026-09-26): 'serber spinal' -> 'cerebrospinal' is a 2->1 word collapse, and fix-vtt-names.js cannot express it (the two words sit on different cue lines). It was applied by hand to public/captions/stolen-focus.vtt instead - a -1 word edit that moved exactly ONE beat (#125) and left the other 289 byte-identical, so it never needed names.json. DELIBERATELY LEFT (guessing a proper noun is worse than shipping the ASR text — listed here so the operator can check the audio against the book): the prisoner's name 'Moric', 'Moritz' (probably 'memoirs'), 'Tim's books' (the Provincetown bookshop scene), 'Kayafe' in the gas-mask quote, 'Raymond Maher' (fiction researcher; first name certain, surname not), and 'serber spinal' (should read 'cerebrospinal' — the ASR put the two words on different cue lines, and merging them shifts the beat grid, so it waits for an explicit decision).
